message.reasoning_content: I'm president (influence 1 + tie_order priority). Cash 21.25, promissory 21.25. Round 3 action. Selling later at declining prices; produce gives goods. But influence matters: фракция 0 has influence 2, so next law round they might be president? Law president = highest influence at law entry. I have 1, фракция 0 has 2 — I'd lose presidency unless I bribe. Bribe 5 to 0 gives me influence 2 — but tie at 2, priority tie_order: I'm idx1, tie_order [1,2,0] so I win. But bribing 0 gives them 3? No, bribe gives influence to sender, cash to receiver. So bribe 5 → I get 2, фракция 0 stays at 2 (cash to them). Tie broken by tie_order → I hold presidency. That costs 5 alashi but keeps veto/vote control and 5% commission bonus. Also bribe cash to rival weakens rank. Alternatively produce goods worth more. Presidency gives 5% bank (~1.5 alashi) plus veto power. Keeping presidency seems worth 5. Also need goods for income — but only one action. Round 3 of 6; still rounds 4-6 for production. I'll bribe 5 to 0? That gives them 5 cash though. Bribe to 2 instead — also fine, keeps influence 2. Choice 11.
